text:
Dilute sulfuric acid is electrolysed using platinum electrodes. The gases produced at each
electrode are collected.
The gases are mixed together and ignited with a lighted splint.
What is formed during this reaction?
A
hydrogen sulfide
B
sulfur dioxide
C
sulfuric acid
D
water
subject: Chemistry
